title.zh: 运行上的更新与生生的关系读法
title.en: Renewal on runs and the relational reading of living

statement.zh: 更新与消耗为运行分类：任一过程的每次运行，经条件的可观测量读出，都是这些类所适用之网；自某步起不再上升的自然数可观测量，不在任意晚的步下降；自同一配置，一次运行可以更新，另一次可以消耗。
statement.en: Renewal and consumption classify runs: each run of any process, read through observables of conditions, is a web to which the classes apply; a natural-number observable never rising from some step on does not fall at arbitrarily late steps; from one configuration one run can renew, another consume.

laws.en: Read through observables of conditions (levels and activity at each configuration; requirements, needs and draws fixed), a run of any process is one relational unfolding whose levels and activity are those of its configurations step by step; its static web is the run read through the same dependences, and the classes of renewing and consuming formation are defined on the unfolding.
laws.zh: 经条件的可观测量（每个配置上的水平与活跃；所需、需要量与汲取固定）读出，任一过程的一次运行是一个关系展开，其水平与活跃逐步即其配置的水平与活跃；其静态网即经同一依存读出的该运行，更新与消耗之形成的类在该展开上定义。

laws.en: A natural-number observable that does not rise across any step from step T on does not fall at arbitrarily late steps.
laws.zh: 从第 T 步起跨任一步都不上升的自然数可观测量，不在任意晚的步下降。

laws.en: Depletion, a case of that principle: where every admissible step of a process lowers a natural-number reserve of the configuration, the process has no run, and no sequence of configurations and moves takes an admissible step at every index.
laws.zh: 耗竭是该原则的情形：过程的每个可容许步都降低配置的一项自然数储备时，该过程没有运行，也没有在每个下标都走一个可容许步的配置与动作序列。

laws.en: Recurrent renewal, a case of that principle: along a run of any process where every step that is not a renewal lowers a natural-number rank of the configuration, no tail of the run, from whatever step, is free of renewal.
laws.zh: 复现的更新是该原则的情形：沿任一过程的一次运行，凡不是更新的步都降低配置的一项自然数秩时，该运行从任何一步起的尾段都不是没有更新的。

laws.en: Unrenewed drawdown, a case of that principle: along a run of any process, where from step T on a condition's level never rises across a step and falls across every step at which a formation is active, the formation is not active at arbitrarily late steps.
laws.zh: 无更新的汲取是该原则的情形：沿任一过程的一次运行，从第 T 步起某条件的水平跨任一步都不上升、且在某形成活跃的每一步都下降时，该形成不在任意晚的步活跃。

laws.en: In a process where a condition gains one unit a step and the move is the amount drawn, the runs drawing one unit and two units a step start at one configuration, with the focal formation active at every step of both: drawing one, it renews; drawing two, it consumes the condition, and in that run the sustaining formation, which depends on it at need one, is inactive at every step from one on.
laws.zh: 在条件每步增一单位、动作即汲取量的过程中，每步汲取一单位与两单位的两次运行始于同一配置，焦点形成在两者的每一步都活跃：汲取一单位时它更新；汲取两单位时它消耗该条件，该运行中以需要量一依存于该条件的维持形成从第一步起每步都不活跃。

hypotheses.zh: 条件水平、活跃、依存（及其水平）与汲取是配置上的可观测量；依存与汲取不随配置变化。
hypotheses.en: Levels of conditions, activity, dependence (with its level) and drawing are observables of configurations; dependence and drawing do not vary with the configuration.

hypotheses.zh: living 取整段运行上的关系读法（活跃且不消耗），是公开的读法选择，不是被证明的对应。
hypotheses.en: `living` is the whole-run relational reading (active and not consuming), a disclosed reading choice, not a proved correspondence.

does_not_show.en: It proves none of self-significance, both neutralities, A, C, L or the practical commitments, and binds no position that rejects them.
does_not_show.zh: 不证明自身意义、两种中立、A、C、L 或实践承诺，不约束拒绝它们的立场。

does_not_show.en: The three bounds are cases of one principle, an organization of known bounds rather than new mathematics.
does_not_show.zh: 三条界是同一原则的情形，这是已知之界的组织，不是新数学。

does_not_show.en: The principle is not shown to give the well-founded form of recurrent renewal, more general than a natural-number rank.
does_not_show.zh: 未表明该原则给出复现更新的良基形式，该形式比自然数秩更一般。

does_not_show.en: Neither the philosophical warrant for the whole-run relational reading nor that it is the right reading of 生生 is shown.
does_not_show.zh: 整段运行上的关系读法的哲学根据，以及它是否为生生的正确读法，都未表明。

does_not_show.en: The reading is of the whole run, relative to that run, with dependence and drawing fixed and no component of further generation; no correspondence discipline for conditions is stated for it.
does_not_show.zh: 读法是整段运行上的，相对于该运行，依存与汲取固定，不含继续生成的成分；没有为它陈述条件的对应纪律。

does_not_show.en: A formation's class depends on its identity across steps; a condition's class does not.
does_not_show.zh: 形成的类依赖于跨步的同一，条件的类不依赖。

does_not_show.en: The renewable witness has no feedback: its loss beyond renewal lasts only while drawing exceeds renewal, so it shows no irreversible loss.
does_not_show.zh: 可更新条件的见证没有反馈：超出更新的损失只在汲取超出更新时持续，所以它不表明不可逆的损失。

Bridge and RenewalComparison are provenance. Author counterreview in the integration note; four independent reviews read it, and their corrections were taken.
validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器实查：核心模块 Becoming.Renewal、Labelled、Frame、Ranking、Metaethics、ValuationFrames 与基础模块 RelationalRenewal 的当前字节绑定 becoming-checks 下通过的回执，所引声明的公理报告皆空；检查器并核对核心只用 Lean 前导即可编译。Bridge 与 RenewalComparison 是来源。作者反审见整合文档；四次独立审查读过它，其更正已采纳。

next_delta.en: Extend the correspondence discipline for conditions to the whole-run reading; give a reading independent of the run, connected to the universal reason; establish the empirical correspondence of common conditions.
next_delta.zh: 把条件的对应纪律推广到整段读法；给出不依赖运行、并与普遍理由接通的读法；确立共同条件的经验对应。

correspondence.en: Formations and conditions are analytic roles in one unfolding, not independent entities or owners of value. What counts as a condition and as participation decides connection, which significance-through-a-common-condition states with its caveat on idle conditions; a too coarse common condition empties living, which condition-correspondence-discipline does not resolve. The reading is relative to a run. The correspondence of observables to an actual history, whether a common condition (such as the biosphere or climate) is in fact participated in by every living formation, and whether the relational reading is the right reading of 生生 are application or philosophical duties.
correspondence.zh: 形成与条件是同一展开中的分析角色，不是独立实体或价值所有者。什么算条件、什么算参与决定连通，由 significance-through-a-common-condition 陈述，并附其关于惰性条件之限；过粗的共同条件使 living 变空，condition-correspondence-discipline 不解决此点。读法相对于一次运行。可观测量与实际历史的对应、共同条件（如生物圈、气候）是否真被所有活的形成参与，以及关系读法是否为生生的正确读法，都是应用或哲学上的对应义务。

detail.zh: 该结果的窄定律类与生生之意义接口独立于本读法；本结果不建立二者间的转换。
detail.en: That result's narrower law class and living-significance interface are independent of this reading; no conversion between them is established.

detail.zh: 分类表中原留给 P3b 的两个模块，由本结果归入运行上的更新界。
detail.en: The two modules the classification left to P3b are placed by this result as renewal bounds on runs.

detail.zh: 该结果给出一条条件的对应纪律：只有交互才经由条件相关；惰性条件不再免费连通，在声明的类中连通仍成立。
detail.en: That result states a correspondence discipline for conditions: only interaction relates through a condition; idle conditions no longer connect for free, and connection holds for a declared class.
Reads step by step what this record reads over the whole run: living as active and not undermining.
detail.zh: 逐步读出本记录在整段运行上所读者：living 读作活跃且不侵蚀。

detail.en: Lets dependence vary with the configuration, which the reading here takes as fixed.
detail.zh: 让依存随配置变化，这里的读法则取依存为固定。

detail.en: There following a formation across steps depends on who continues whom; a formation's class here rests on that identity, a condition's does not.
detail.zh: 那里跨步追随一个形成取决于谁延续谁；这里形成的类依赖于这种同一，条件的类不依赖。

history.en: 20 October 2026, R35 (twentieth review, E8): proof references to superseded periphery modules (Bridge and RenewalComparison) re-roled as provenance, with their declarations kept, and their bindings dropped; the current proof is the modules it still cites as proof (Becoming.Frame, Becoming.Labelled, Becoming.Metaethics, Becoming.Ranking, Becoming.Renewal, Becoming.ValuationFrames and RelationalRenewal). The retired modules' content is also stated in Becoming.ActiveReading, which this record does not cite with declarations. The claim is unchanged.

history.en: 25 October 2026, board item DF (study section 418): the retired labels replaced by the current terms in a hypothesis, a dependency, a related detail and the limitations: G0, S0, N_rel and N_std by living significance, self-significance and relational and standpoint neutrality, and in the limitations S0, N and J by self-significance, both neutralities and J1–J4, its clause on rejecting positions reworded to keep the field within its cap. history.en: 27 October 2026, board item DF2 (study section 426): the statement says what the record keeps, the run-class laws (every run a web the classes apply to, a falling natural observable does not recur, and from one configuration one run can renew and another consume); connection through a common condition and transmission along co-participation, with their hypothesis, counterexample and five aliases, moved to significance-through-a-common-condition, at home in 07 §3.1. The run-class laws are unchanged.
history.zh: 2026年10月27日，工作板条目 DF2（研究第 426 节）：陈述改为本记录所保留的运行类律（每次运行都是这些类所适用之网，下降的自然数可观测量不再复现，自同一配置一次运行可以更新、另一次可以消耗）；经共同条件的连通与沿共同参与的传递，连同其假设、反例与五个别名，移至 significance-through-a-common-condition，其家在 07 §3.1。运行类律不变。

history.en: 28 October 2026: migrated to schema 2 (DF3 batch B, study section 441): title and statement kept; the claim split into six laws, each read against its declarations in Renewal.lean, Labelled.lean and RelationalRenewal.lean (a run read as one unfolding, the principle, depletion, recurrent renewal, unrenewed drawdown, the class belonging to the run), the negated universals kept as the Lean has them; the limitations and the three counterexamples, none of which a declaration witnesses, to seven does-not-show items, the standard boundaries no-ethical-premise and discrete-steps and three related entries (becoming-stepwise-reading, becoming-dependence-dynamics, identity-across-steps); the retired label J1–J4 replaced by the practical commitments; the second hypothesis's pointer to significance-through-a-common-condition cut, that record depending on this one; a review-item label cut from the correspondence; Web.conditions_along, Renewable.process, Renewable.withinRenewal and Renewable.beyondRenewal added to Labelled.lean's references and Renewable.conditions to Renewal.lean's; no premise, status, source hash or proof binding changed. Every earlier sentence is mapped in [becoming-renewal-reading.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-repository-reconciliation/architecture/df/df3-mapping/becoming-renewal-reading.md); the exact earlier record is the first text_versions entry. The migration's skeptical review was taken in laws, each read against the Lean it cites.
